aot.description: Ordinary DOM/jsdom AOT linkage. No default runtime features and no dynamic-js.

x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.note: LayoutNG stays in the runtime binary: W3COS_LAYOUT_NG selects it at run time, so release-size LTO keeps the S1-S5 block, inline, float, and nowrap-flex code. On x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu with Rust 1.99.1 the stripped AOT probe is 12132480 bytes (+254904, 2.15%) and the dynamic-browser probe is 15618448 bytes (+245816, 1.60%), past the 200 KiB absolute gate and under the 3% gate. Image codecs, web-bluetooth, web-geolocation, host-tray, and host-keyring stay off.

retired.name: monaco-full-runtime-arm64-macos
retired.reason: The single about-172-MB-unstripped / about-120-MB-stripped arm64 macOS Monaco artifact mixed application modules with every default runtime feature and is not a same-runner measurement. CI tracks per-closure linkage baselines in this file instead. Render, font, and image-codec product slices are outside this gate.
